Question: How can a unique five-element Co–Cu–Fe–Ni–Zn high entropy alloy thin film be synthesized in a single step to achieve soft magnetic properties with high saturation magnetization and low coercivity, overcoming the challenges of anomalous deposition and phase control in aqueous media?. System: Co–Cu–Fe–Ni–Zn high entropy alloy (near equi-atomic composition). Processing: Pulse electrodeposition in aqueous medium at ~45 ºC; optimized parameters: forward ON time 50 ms, OFF time 10 ms, applied potential 1.5 V (potentiostatic mode), using sodium citrate as complexing agent and boric acid as buffer.. Test conditions: Room temperature characterization; Magnetic properties measured via Vibrating Sample Magnetometry (VSM) and Ferromagnetic Resonance (FMR) from 9 to 18 GHz; Microstructure analyzed via FESEM, STEM-EDS, 2D X-ray diffraction, and HRTEM.. Findings: The fabricated Co–Cu–Fe–Ni–Zn HEA thin films exhibited a saturation magnetization (Ms) of ~82 emu/
